integrity: One concrete mathematically proved law; exhaustive small-size tests corroborate, but cannot replace the asymptotic proof. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Boolean alphabet, IID uniform colours and exactly equal finite S5 equivalence-class sizes; no claim for multi-agent or variable-size or dependent models. Exact static colour-support normal forms and elementary occupancy bounds are prior ingredients; historical priority for their probabilistic combination is not independently established.
title: Multicritical Poisson–binomial laws for finite non-contingency algebras
